blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Maynila (PLM) has admitted only 3,000 of more than 70,000 applicants for academic year 2026-2027, its president said Monday. Lawyer Domingo Reyes Jr., president of PLM, said during the flag-raising ceremony at Manila City Hall that while 43,000 applicants were able to take the entrance exam, only 3,000 were accepted “because we can no longer accommodate” more students. Reyes said online applications for the next school year will close on Wednesday, Sept. 30, and that 65,000 individuals have already submitted applications. “We apologize, we cannot admit everyone who wants to have an education […]...
